scope: Observed original boolean data preferences, credential-free local adapter only

contract.read: GET /settings/user -> settings with boolean training_allowed and precise_location_allowed
contract.originalBehavior: Training switch observes account and policy guards, patches preference and invalidates user settings; errors produce original toast. Location preference has additional permission handling.

implementation: Atomic sidecar <sidebar-settings-file>.preferences.json, strict observed boolean keys. Existing sidebar file preserved byte-for-byte. No remote mutation or OS location permission implementation.
validation: 56 Node tests pass. v53 original Data controls switch Allow chats to improve the model began false/enabled. Real pointer click set aria-checked true and persisted training_allowed true. Renderer reload, original profile Settings menu and Data controls reopened with checked true. Second pointer click restored checked false and persisted false.
